scenes.narration: Your kitchen is about to get a lot smarter. Ovens that see your food, fridges that know what's missing, and cooktops that never let dinner burn. This is sample narration used to test the video pipeline.
Here's a big number. Stats like this pop up over the footage, with the source underneath, while the shots keep moving.

scenes.narration: Trend number three. Cooktops that cook for you. Countdown titles look like this, with the number big and bold.

Sensors watch the pan and turn the heat down before anything burns. Most scenes are just footage like this, cutting to a new shot every few seconds, with no text at all, so the video feels like a film rather than a slideshow.
Trend number two. Robot helpers. A short caption can flash up for a moment and then get out of the way.
And when there's a comparison, a table fills in row by row over one calm shot.
Which of these would you actually use? Tell me in the comments, and subscribe for more of the future.
